# TowFinder Method

TowFinder Method is an informational routing tool that helps people find the appropriate local path after a vehicle is towed and browse nearby official public vehicle-auction resources.

Website: https://towfinder-method.vercel.app/

## Core pages
- Home: https://towfinder-method.vercel.app/
- Car got towed guide: https://towfinder-method.vercel.app/car-got-towed/
- Vehicle auction guide: https://towfinder-method.vercel.app/vehicle-auctions/
- FAQ: https://towfinder-method.vercel.app/faq/

## Key answers
- TowFinder Method does not tow vehicles and is not a government agency.
- It helps users identify the correct local towing, police, parking, or impound resource.
- Some local systems may support searches by license plate, VIN, or other vehicle details.
- Public vehicle auctions may be operated by cities, counties, police departments, fleet agencies, or contracted auction companies.
- Auction requirements, towing fees, release requirements, bidder eligibility, and vehicle status must be verified with the official source.
- No account is required to begin using TowFinder Method.
